title: Where the AI and your June answers disagree
instructions: Each card shows a parent’s note, the answer you confirmed in June, and the answer the AI gives today. For each one, choose My June answer is right, The AI’s answer is right, or Neither. If it could be read either way, say so in the comments. That is as useful as a choice.

items.situation: Making a mistake in a game

log.situation: Making a mistake in a soccer game
log.child: Leo missed an easy goal, then walked off to the far end of the bench and sat by himself. He wouldn't talk to his teammates or the coach for the rest of the game.
log.parent: I told him it was fine and gave him space.

log.situation: At home when M, age 6, and I are not in the same room
log.child: M cries, pleads, hyperventilates, and gets so upset he almost vomits when I have to be out of the house without him for even an hour. He calls out to me, stays by my side, and asks many questions about where I am throughout the day. He refuses sitters.
log.parent: I avoid leaving him; I don't go out unless I must, and never unless his father is home.
